gloss: standing room only; standing audience; standing to watch

definitions.gloss: standing room only; standing audience; standing to watch
definitions.explanation: watching an event, performance, or movie while standing due to no available seats; or the standing area itself

examples.japanese: ⟦{立|た}ち{見席|みせき}→立ち見席：18137_tachimiseki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ほしい。
examples.english: I want a ticket even if it's standing room only.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立|た}ち{見|み}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いっぱいだった。
examples.english: The popular concert was full of standing audience members.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand) + ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to watch) → watching while standing

- Sports events
